summary: GigaMedia Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 4, 2026, to report its first-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing contains only routine quarterly earnings disclosure, including revenues of $0.75 million, a net loss of $0.88 million, and cash of $27.97 million. There is no announcement of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The Form 6-K, filed under the 1934 Act by a foreign private issuer, is the equivalent of a domestic earnings press release. It does not trigger any change-of-control, strategic review, or other extraordinary corporate transaction.
